notes: Machine facts below were independently transcribed from a read-only B-unit boot_b FDT payload. See DT-HARDWARE-FACTS.md for provenance, limitations and omitted dependencies. This record is not a complete or bootable Device Tree.

kernel_binding_validation.evidence: Linux 6.18.55 root and serial dt_binding_check passed in Hosted run 40014932523. The patched partial DTB compiled and the workflow direct dt-validate command completed successfully with the observed mt6873-uart enum correction. This validates only the partial disabled-observation tree, not peripheral driver bindings or bootability. Full MediaTek-wide checks have unrelated legacy warnings.
